sec-head.p: Each stage of system prompt development, tested and refined for reliable, on-brand outputs.

card.p: Articulating the AI's objective, target audience, and persona attributes to shape its fundamental behavior and responses.
Writing explicit context boundaries, format specifications, guardrails, and 'do not' rules that the model must follow with zero ambiguity.
Crafting representative input-output pairs and role-playing examples within the prompt to demonstrate desired output structure and reasoning.
Probing the prompt with jailbreak attempts, contradictory instructions, and off-topic queries to ensure directive adherence.
A/B testing prompt variants against your KPIs and refining language, examples, and constraints to improve consistency and relevance.
Packaging your system prompt into a versioned artifact, integrated with your API, and monitored for drift and output failures.
